table.wrapLinesDescriptionText: Display long text over several lines.
table.stripedRowsDescription: Alternate the background color of the rows.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.descriptionWithAccount: Analysis of the emails received on {account}
dashboard.totalEmailsHint: Emails you received (your own are excluded)
dashboard.uniqueSendersHint: Distinct addresses found in the mailbox

chart.title: Top senders
chart.description: The senders that fill up your mailbox the most
chart.ariaLabel: Senders ranked by number of emails

senders.title: Senders
senders.pageDescription: Search, sort and bulk-clean your senders
senders.tableDescription: Select senders for a bulk cleanup, or click a name to open their emails.
senders.searchPlaceholder: Search a name or an address...
senders.emptyDescription: Run a sync to analyze your Gmail mailbox.
senders.confirmDeleteTitle: Delete the emails of the selected senders

confirmDeleteWarning.one: {count} email from {senders} will be moved to the Gmail trash. The action stays reversible from Gmail for 30 days.
confirmDeleteWarning.other: {count} emails from {senders} will be moved to the Gmail trash. The action stays reversible from Gmail for 30 days.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.pageDescriptionEmpty: Detects the List-Unsubscribe header of your senders and unsubscribes in one click when possible.
unsubscribe.pageDescription: {newsletters} out of {total} senders — {none} without an unsubscribe link, {unknown}.
unsubscribe.tableDescription: Click a name to see its emails. Automatic unsubscribe only covers “link” and “one-click” senders; the others can still be deleted in bulk.
unsubscribe.emptyScanHint: Run a scan to probe your senders.
unsubscribe.emptyNoLinkHint: None of your scanned senders exposes an unsubscribe link.
unsubscribe.confirmRunWarning: An unsubscribe request will be sent directly to {senders}. For plain links (not “one-click”), some senders may require an extra confirmation on their own page — an HTTP OK response therefore does not guarantee that the request was processed on the other end.

manualSelectionNote.one: {count} selected sender only offers an email unsubscribe — use the “Open the email” link in the table, it is not included here.
manualSelectionNote.other: {count} selected senders only offer an email unsubscribe — use the “Open the email” link in the table, they are not included here.

confirmDeleteWarning.one: {count} email from {senders} will be moved to the Gmail trash — without any unsubscribe attempt. The action stays reversible from Gmail for 30 days.
confirmDeleteWarning.other: {count} emails from {senders} will be moved to the Gmail trash — without any unsubscribe attempt. The action stays reversible from Gmail for 30 days.

unsubscribe.searchPlaceholder: Search a name or an address...

emailsPanel.title: Emails received
emailsPanel.emptyList: No email left from this sender.

confirmTrashBody.one: {count} email from {sender} will be moved to the Gmail trash. The action stays reversible from Gmail for 30 days.
confirmTrashBody.other: {count} emails from {sender} will be moved to the Gmail trash. The action stays reversible from Gmail for 30 days.

preview.title: Email preview
preview.subtitle: Preview
preview.noSelectionDescription: Click the subject of an email to display it here.
preview.remoteImagesBlocked: Remote images are blocked (they let the sender track when the email is opened).

toast.backendUnreachableContent: {message} — check that the API is running on port 8000.
toast.syncFailedFallback: An error occurred during the sync.

deleteDoneSenders.one: {count} email from {senders} moved to the trash{errors}.
deleteDoneSenders.other: {count} emails from {senders} moved to the trash{errors}.

deleteSenderDone.one: {count} email from {sender} moved to the trash{errors}.{unsubNote}
deleteSenderDone.other: {count} emails from {sender} moved to the trash{errors}.{unsubNote}

apiError.token_missing: token.json not found. Run main.py first.
apiError.token_invalid: Invalid Gmail token. Run main.py again to re-authenticate.
